<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Principal Officers; Election
of Directors; Appointment of Principal Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><U>Departure of Named Executive Officer</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">As previously disclosed, on March 30, 2021, Pactiv Evergreen Inc. (the
&ldquo;Company&rdquo;) announced that John Rooney, the Company&rsquo;s President of Beverage Merchandising and the Chief Executive Officer
of Evergreen Packaging LLC (&ldquo;Evergreen&rdquo;), an indirect subsidiary of the Company, will be leaving the Company effective as
of June 30, 2021 (the &ldquo;Separation Date&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">In connection with his departure, Mr. Rooney has entered into a separation
agreement (the &ldquo;Separation Agreement&rdquo;). Pursuant to his Separation Agreement, which includes a customary release of claims
in favor of the Company, Mr. Rooney will be entitled to: (i) severance of $87,500 per calendar month for 24 months following the Separation
Date, (ii) a payment in respect of his vacation accrual for 2021 (less any vacation taken in 2021 prior to the Separation Date) plus additional
vacation benefits payable in a lump sum of $96,000 under an Evergreen program for certain long tenured employees, (iii) COBRA continuation
premium payments at the active employee rate for up to 12 months following the Separation Date and (iv) the continued vesting of any restricted
stock units awarded to Mr. Rooney in 2020.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The receipt of Mr. Rooney&rsquo;s severance benefits was contingent
upon him agreeing to restrictive covenants, including: (i) a 24-month post-termination non-compete, (ii) a 24-month post-termination non-solicit
of the Company&rsquo;s employees or current or prospective customers, (iii) a perpetual confidentiality covenant and (iv) an assignment
of inventions provision.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The foregoing description of
the Separation Agreement contained herein does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the complete
text of the Separation Agreement. A copy of the Separation Agreement will be filed as an exhibit to the Registrant&rsquo;s quarterly report
on Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2021.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
